name: Order-Independent Volumetric Compositing via Visibility Function
definition: A technique to composite semi-transparent volumetric samples in an order-independent manner by using a visibility function representing total transmittance between a sample and the camera, enabling correct direct volume rendering beyond MIP and X-ray representations.
summary: Order-Independent Volumetric Compositing via Visibility Function composites semi-transparent volume samples without sorting by using a visibility function to weight contributions, solving order-dependent transparency issues.
